risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Documented past incidents: ransomware July 2018 on Dx systems (without data theft), AMCA security incident May 2019 involving patient data. Ongoing litigation and government investigations. Risk heightened by critical IT dependency for clinical operations and sensitive data.

risks.title: Regulation and Public Funding
risks.score_rationale: OBBBA enacted July 2025 introduces Medicaid/ACA changes with provisions effective through 2028. Documented risk of reduced diagnostic services utilization via insurance coverage reduction. Management estimates impact currently non-material but evaluation ongoing.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Fragmented diagnostics market with regional and national competitors. Labcorp maintains position via acquisitions (Invitae, SYNLAB) and healthcare system partnerships (13 transactions in 2025). Moderate competitive risk given scale and diversified portfolio.

risks.title: Technology Dependency and Systems Integration
risks.score_rationale: IT critical for operations: 750M tests annually, 71,000 employees, 100 countries. Post-acquisition integrations (Invitae, SYNLAB, EdBertha) complex. Risk of system outages, data issues or cybersecurity failures.

risks.title: Litigation and Contingencies
risks.score_rationale: Active litigation related to 2019 AMCA incident, ongoing government and regulatory investigations. ED restructuring charges of $127.2M in 2025 signal potential additional costs. Reputational risk and material legal/settlement costs.

ai_positioning.summary: Labcorp does not explicitly mention AI or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. References focus on diagnostic technology, scientific innovation and analytical capabilities, without direct mention of AI applications.
